_readme: SKULL Secret Shop — registry of EXTERNAL, third-party tools SKULL may recommend for a project. SKULL does not vendor these; it points you at the upstream and (with your ok) helps you install them. Never auto-install; recommend + let the user run the command. See SKILL.md.

hub.name: Claude Skills Hub
hub.note: Public directory of ~15k community skills. Use it to recommend skills on demand. Read a skill's source repo before suggesting an install. Never auto-install from the hub.

tools.name: graphify
tools.what: Turns the repo (plus docs, SQL, configs, PDFs) into a queryable knowledge graph via local tree-sitter AST parsing — no LLM, no vector store. The agent queries the graph instead of reading whole files.
tools.impact: ~70x fewer read tokens on large repos; edges tagged EXTRACTED vs INFERRED; 31+ languages.
tools.install: uv tool install graphify && graphify install --project
tools.leader_rule: On a big repo, or when reading files dominates the token cost, query graphify instead of grep/read crawls.

tools.name: caveman
tools.what: Instructs the agent to drop filler and answer in tight fragments — code, commands and errors kept byte-for-byte exact. One installer auto-detects your agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI).
tools.caveat: Only shrinks OUTPUT; adds ~1-1.5k input tokens/turn, so on already-terse or reasoning-heavy work it can be net-negative. Pair with graphify (which cuts input) for the full stack.
tools.verify: the caveman skill/plugin shows up in your agent's skill list
tools.leader_rule: On long, output-heavy sessions where sheer output volume (not reasoning) is the cost. Skip it on short or already-terse work.

tools.name: Context7
tools.what: An MCP server that fetches version-correct library docs at query time, so you stop pasting stale docs and inventing APIs.
tools.impact: Current, version-pinned docs injected on demand.
tools.install: add the MCP server to your agent's MCP config (e.g. npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp)
tools.verify: the context7 MCP tools appear in your agent
tools.leader_rule: When writing against a library or framework, pull current docs via Context7 instead of trusting training-cutoff memory.

tools.name: CodeGraph
tools.what: A local AST code knowledge graph exposed over MCP — call graph, impact analysis, dead-code — for semantic queries instead of grep crawls.
tools.impact: Symbol-level retrieval and real call/impact edges.
tools.install: run the CodeGraph MCP server and add it to your agent's MCP config
tools.verify: the codegraph MCP tools appear in your agent
tools.leader_rule: On a big repo, ask the graph for call/impact instead of reading every caller by hand.

tools.name: Serena
tools.what: LSP-powered symbol-level navigation and edits over MCP — go-to-def, find-references, precise renames without reading whole files.
tools.impact: Language-server accuracy for navigation and edits.
tools.install: run the Serena MCP server and add it to your agent's MCP config
tools.verify: the serena MCP tools appear in your agent
tools.leader_rule: For precise symbol navigation or a wide rename/refactor on a large codebase, use Serena over grep.

tools.name: RTK
tools.what: A CLI proxy that compresses command and log output (60-90% fewer tokens) before it reaches the model; installs as a PreToolUse hook.
tools.impact: 60-90% fewer tokens on captured command/log output.
tools.install: install the RTK CLI and register it as a PreToolUse hook (see the repo)
tools.leader_rule: When tool or log output is voluminous, route it through RTK so the model reads a compressed view.

tools.name: Tokscale
tools.what: Tracks token usage across your agents like an infra cost — per model, per day, per session.
tools.impact: Visibility into where tokens actually go.
tools.install: install the Tokscale CLI (see the repo)
tools.leader_rule: When a budget is set or cost matters, track the burn with Tokscale and report at checkpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Presidio
tools.what: Detects and de-identifies PII (analyzer + anonymizer + image/DICOM redactor): mask, redact, hash, or encrypt. The engine behind SKULL's sec-pii skill.
tools.impact: PII redacted before it reaches a model, a log, or a third party.
tools.install: pip install presidio-analyzer presidio-anonymizer && python -m spacy download en_core_web_lg
tools.leader_rule: Before any user data (names, emails, IDs, cards, medical) reaches a model, a log, or a third party, redact it with Presidio first.
